title: Fuding facility reaches 400 t monthly output
excerpt: Our Fujian production line has reached a sustained monthly capacity of 400 tons, enabling stable lead times for international orders.
body: Our production facility in Fuding, Fujian has reached a sustained monthly output of 400 tons, following a line expansion in early 2025.
The facility covers the full manufacturing chain: cold heading, thread rolling, heat treatment, plating and packaging, all under one roof across 6,000 m².
The increased capacity means shorter lead times for repeat orders and greater flexibility on mixed-variety programs for international retail buyers.
